purpose: Empirical temporal-alignment audit of the frozen pre-2018 Quiniela rule on the subsequently imported 2018-2026 official archive. The exact forecast systems are kept fixed; real 14-sign outcome vectors are randomly permuted across dates, preserving their full empirical distribution and breaking only forecast/result alignment.
limitations: This tests the already-frozen rule only; it does not correct the original 500,000-candidate selection process or all project-wide research families.
2018-2026 is historical post-freeze replication within this pipeline, not real-time prospective evidence.
Permuting complete outcome vectors preserves empirical sign-pattern difficulty but removes calendar/season structure.
Real-money remains disabled; 216 columns are costly and hit-rate significance does not imply positive ROI.
